A few Anya moments 📸

Something I wanted to say ❤️

Happy Birthday, Anya! 🎂✨

I don't know how this year is going to turn out, or where life will take either of us, but I do know one thing — I genuinely want to see you happy and doing well.

You've become someone I care about, and no matter what the future looks like, I'll always want the best for you. If you ever need someone to listen, to support you, or simply stand beside you when things aren't going great, you can count on me.

And yes, maybe there are a few feelings from my side that I've already told you about. I don't want this birthday wish to put any pressure on you or ask you for an answer. I just wanted you to know that my care for you is real, and your place in my life matters to me. 🫶🏻

I hope this new year of your life brings you peace, beautiful memories, success, and a lot of reasons to smile. Stay the same sweet, crazy and lovely person you are. 🌸

Happy Birthday once again, Anya. ♡
— From someone who's always rooting for you
